label: Game experience
tagline: Living interactive worlds with an objective — agency, juice, score, feedback loop
description: Crafts full-bleed game-like immersive pieces where the user drives with drag / touch / multi-touch and the scene responds with physics + particle feedback toward a stated objective (score / progress / streak / win-condition). The fifth planner sibling — inherits simulation-planner's discipline (paradigm space, research-then-drawers shape, lens trio with loop-until-bar, multi-draft cruxes via iterator-remix, hand-off split). What changes is purpose: where simulation gives the user UNDERSTANDING of a system, interactive-media makes the body the creative material, and narrative-experience gives presence in a place — game-experience gives AGENCY toward an OBJECTIVE inside a LIVING WORLD. Three load-bearing words. Agency means input feels direct (drag / touch / multi-touch / gestures with ≤50ms response). Objective means a goal that climbs (score, progress, streak, level). Living world means full-bleed scenes with no flat resting state — ambient motion always, physics + particles + feedback on action, UI peeks at the edge and never frames the action. Five paradigms (2d-side / 2d-topdown / 3d-environment / iconographic-physics / hybrid) map onto game-experience naturally. Collaborates with visual-planner for hero plates / sprites / texture atlases so every plate inherits the brief's styleCue. Concept-lens scores against felt-game-feel successFeel ('every throw feels weighty and the world rewards it'), never generic claims ('the user has fun').

triggers.title: Path A — "build an app/site" with this game-piece inside
triggers.rule: User wants the game embedded in a larger surface (a homepage with an interactive hero, an article with a playable diagram, a portfolio with a toy). Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell (with `<iframe class="game-mount" data-game=...>` slot + `allow=` attribute), then dispatches game-experience-planner per slot (Mode A envelope with slotFile/slotLine). After the planner returns the hand-off envelope, top-level Claude drives the build phase per game-experience-planner.md §5.1.0 and embeds per §5.1.1.
triggers.ruleSource: editor/kinds/capabilities.py — 'Game-like immersive piece: dispatch game-experience-planner FIRST' Path A

triggers.title: Path B — Bare intent (the default for game)
triggers.rule: User wants the piece itself (a one-shot game / toy / playable artefact). Default for game. Top-level Claude dispatches game-experience-planner directly in BARE-INTENT MODE. The runtime IS the artefact; no app shell needed.
